Potentially daylight savings time zone issue.

- Wonder why this happens only on Monday 🤔 
- The data time zone is fixed at UTC-05, the exchange is America/New_York which goes from UTC-05 to UTC-04. So, midnight in exchange time zone, **the end time**, will be 1 hour behind that the data time zone midnight in some cases.
- Since the algorithm is asking at midnight America/New_York, exchange time zone, it still missing 1 hour for that data to be there (?), isn't then the **start** time wrong? maybe related to the fact this happens only on Mondays too. 🐞 
- Using Resolution Daily for the added forex on initialize, should do the trick, since it wouldn't ask at mightnight but at 1 AM America/New_York, since that's when the data comes through, **but** the end time is being cropped https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Time.cs#L460 (called by https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Data/HistoryRequestFactory.cs#L97), seems this should be using `ExchangeRoundDownInTimeZone` instead 🤔 🐛

Believe this bug is in the start time, `GetStartTimeForTradeBars`, it gets the start time removing the expected bar size in exchange time zone, but I think it should actually be using data time zone, this is happening because FXCM has 1 hour difference between both timezones
